question.text: A PM constructs an immunized portfolio. The most common ACTIVE element required even in 'passive' immunization is:

answer.text: Rebalancing duration whenever yields move significantly

explanation.text: The Logic: Immunization is NOT fire-and-forget — every yield move changes bond durations, requiring rebalance to keep portfolio duration = liability duration. The Trap: Immunization strategies are often wrongly called pure passive; they require ongoing duration matching. Cross-Exam Context: Core XXI-B content. Manager's Pro-Tip: Monthly or trigger-based rebalancing balances transaction cost vs immunization precision — trigger at duration drift > 0.25 years for most portfolios.
